description: Land Title Settlement Department - Radawana (Block 02), Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511049
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title determination, cadastral maps, and property ownership claims in specific districts (Gampaha, Kurunegala, and Kandy), which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
